text.description_html:
Deltana WBHD12, Modern Rectangular HD Wire Basket

Stylish as it is functional, Deltana's Rectangular HD Wire Basket is perfect for homes with modern decor. The WBHD12R Wire Basket is useful to store anything from hand soap to shampoo, or even books or spices. The shelf is designed to utilize often wasted space. It easily mounts to the wall and is made out of solid brass. It is available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes; and it is made with the attention to high quality that is expected of Deltana. Never have storage issues again!

Also Available:
Deltana WBHDUC9 9 Inch HD Universal Corner Bathroom Basket
Deltana WBHDCR9 9 Inch HD Right Corner Bathroom Basket

Shop more of the Deltana Wire Baskets

Features and Specifications of the WBHD12 Solid Brass Modern Rectangular Shelf:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Shelf Length: 12-1/4"
  • Shelf Width: 4-1/2"
  • Height: 1-3/4"
  • Deltana WBHD12R 12-1/4" HD Rectangular Basket Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 basket, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
